name: keel-stats
description: NBA and NFL advanced statistics, ratings and projections.

interface.longDescription: Keel Stats brings NBA and NFL advanced statistics into your conversation. Ask about any player or team and get season and recent numbers with the context behind them: NBA efficiency (true shooting, usage, box plus-minus) and our Keel Impact rating built from RAPM and a box-score prior; NFL expected points added per play and success rate from our own model. See tonight's games with live and final scores and pre-game win probabilities, any team's next and last games, two teams' head-to-head history with their last meetings, standings and weekly NFL power rankings, what each defense allows to every position, and the injury report with what a player's absence changes for his team: the projected margin, and which teammates take on his minutes, targets or carries. Every answer links to the matching page on keelstats.com, so you can check the numbers and read further. Keel Stats is a statistics service: it takes no bets and gives no picks. It works without an account, with a player’s last five games; sign in with a Keel Stats account for his last ten, past seasons and older games.
defaultPrompt: What NBA games are on tonight and what are each team's win chances?
Show Nikola Jokic's advanced stats and Keel Impact this season.
Celtics vs Knicks: their record and last meetings.

positive.description: See tonight's games with win chances
positive.prompt: What NBA games are on tonight and who is favoured?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the day's NBA games with start times and pre-game win probabilities, each with a link to its keelstats.com page.

positive.description: Compare a player's season with his recent form
positive.prompt: Compare Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's efficiency this season to his last 10 games.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the player, then shows season and last-10 numbers such as points, true shooting and usage, with a link to his page.

positive.prompt: Which teams allow the most points to centers this season?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns teams ranked by points allowed to centers, 1 being the most allowed, with a link to the table.

positive.prompt: Who is on the Lakers' injury report and how does it change their next game?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the team, lists its injury report, and explains the effect on the projected margin and on teammates' minutes, with links.

positive.prompt: Top 10 NFL offenses by EPA per play this season.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the ten best offenses by expected points added per play this season, with a link to the rankings.

positive.prompt: Celtics vs Knicks this season and their last meetings
positive.expected_behavior: Finds both teams, then gives their record over every meeting held, this season's series, the last meetings with each game's top player and the next game, with a link to the matchup page.

positive.prompt: When do the Cowboys play next?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the team and returns its next game with the opponent, the date and time (US Eastern) and a link to the game's page.

negative.description: Placing a bet is not supported
negative.prompt: Place a $50 bet on the Celtics moneyline for me.

negative.description: A sport we do not cover
negative.prompt: Who will win the 2027 World Cup?

publication.release_notes: New statistics tools: tonight's expected minutes for every NBA player after the injury report; shot quality (expected field-goal percentage and shot making) for players, teams and defenses; NBA five-man units and how a team does without a player; NFL target, carry and red-zone shares; players most like a given player and how often he reaches a number; and a player's matchup against his next opponent in the defense tables. Answers are shorter and arrive faster: a player’s last five games without an account and his last ten once you sign in. When an answer leaves something out, it says which statistics a connected account adds for that question.
